issue: Capacity-baseline / per-phase-increment conflict flagged in the ChatGPT audit (Calamarí '450 MPCD' vs a 400->475->533 build-up). Two self-consistent framings of the SAME terminal reach the SAME milestones (475 MMcf/d, then 533 MMcf/d): (A) GEM models base = 400 MMcf/d, Phase 1 Expansion = +75, Phase 2 Expansion = +58 (400+75+58 = 533); this matches LNG Prime's FID coverage ('from a current limit of 400 MMscfd ... up to 533 MMscfd', 2025-11-11, PASS). (B) The operator's own sources model base = 450 MMcf/d, first phase = +25 to 475, second phase = +58 to 533: Calamarí facilities page states '450 MPCD' as current capacity, and Valora Analitik (2025-09-04, PASS) says the plant went 'de 450 a 475' on 2025-09-01. So GEM's Phase 1 Expansion increment (+75) is overstated relative to the operator's +25, because GEM uses a 400 baseline while SPEC/Calamarí use 450. GEM's project TOTAL (533) is correct and the modeling is internally coherent; this is a source disagreement on how the increments are apportioned, not a stale total. Note also a units gloss to ignore: Calamarí 'MPCD' = millones de pies cúbicos por día (MMcf/d), not 'million pounds per day'.
suggested_action: Do NOT auto-change GEM capacity figures. Record the conflict and decide apportionment in a normal Update pass: either keep GEM's 400+75+58 build-up (matches LNG Prime FID) or realign to the operator's 450+25+58 (matches Calamarí + Valora). Either way the 533 total and the 475 interim milestone are confirmed. See wiki entry 'Cartagena/SPEC capacity build-up'.
